[Verse1]
[Cm]
Father's hands
[Cm/Eb]are lined with dirt
[Fsus2]From long
days in the field
[Cm]Mother's hands are
[Cm/Eb]serving meals
[Fsus2]In a
cafe on Main Street
[Cm]With mouths to fe-
[Cm/Eb]ed
[Fsus2]Just trying to keep
clothing on our
[Cm]backs And [Cm/Eb]all I hear
about
[Fsus2]Is how it's so bad,
It's so bad It's too bad

[Chorus]
[Ab5]it's too bad Too late,
[Eb5]so wrong, so long
[F5]
It's too bad we had
[Ab5]no time to rewind
[Eb5]Let's walk, let's talk
[F5]

[Cm]
[Cm/Eb]
[Fsus2]

[Cm/Eb]out saying goodbye
[Fsus2]Although
I'm sure you tried
[Cm]You'd call the house
[Cm/Eb]from time to time
[Fsus2]To make
sure we're alive
[Cm]But you weren't there
[Cm/Eb]
[Fsus2]Right when I needed
you the most
[Cm]And now I dream
[Cm/Eb]about it
[Fsus2]And how it's so bad,
it's so bad It's too bad
